content: It is worth noting that a hand-tailored solution for the CookingWorld games has been proposed in the “First TextWorld Problems” competition BIBREF3. This solution managed to obtain up to 91.9% of the maximum possible score across the 514 test games on an unpublished dataset. However, this solution relies on entity extraction and template filling, which we believe limits its potential for generalization. Therefore, this approach should be viewed as complementary rather than competitor to our approach as it could potentially be used as an alternative way of getting promising trajectories.
